brief:
Thousands gathered in Tel Aviv on Saturday for a large anti-government demonstration, according to Al-Monitor, three days ahead of a general election widely viewed as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The demonstration reflected sharp disagreements within Israeli society over Netanyahu's leadership and policies as voters prepared to cast ballots in an election expected to reshape the country's political landscape.

title: Thousands protest Netanyahu in Tel Aviv before election vote
